name: Crinkle-Cut Golden French Fries
whyItWorks: Crinkle-cut potatoes offer deep grooves that trap significant cooking oil during deep-frying. For Crohn's and UC patients, deep-fried vegetable oil can irritate gut mucosa and stimulate bile dumping.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Fried Food Warning: Best reserved for stable remission. During flares, request soft white toast or a plain bun instead.
